Multiple fact-checks refute the image claims. Africa Check concluded hot lemon water doesn't kill cancer cells, and Full Fact found there is no scientific evidence that drinking lemon mixed with hot water causes cancer to disappear or cures cancer. No doctors confirm this cure. There is no separate event claim to assess.

prosecution.text: Full Fact reviewed the claim that drinking lemon mixed with hot water will cause cancer to disappear and found there is no scientific evidence that lemons or lemon juice can cure cancer.
Africa Check directly concluded that hot lemon water does not kill cancer cells, refuting the claim that a morning glass destroys cancer cells.
Logically Facts rated as False the claim that research has shown cancer can be cured with lemon juice and coconut oil.
Full Fact found that social media posts claiming lemons treat cancer better than chemotherapy are false.
Fact-checkers found that lemon-infused hot water does not protect against cancer, contradicting claims of doctors confirming a cure.
Dubawa examined the viral claim that pieces of lemon in a glass of hot water can save you and treated it as an incredulous claim about hot lemon water as a cancer cure.
